models-auto: six (Q20973691), big-six (Q39057611), fifteen (Q1948492) and major-6 (Q1948510) have no years; Big Six is the umbrella for the sixteen/eighteen/twenty-one-twenty-five lines and could be mapped to them; fifteen may be the Fifteen-Six.

summary: Morris card: 151 field changes, mostly closing open production ends (ADO16 1971/1973, ADO17 1975, Ital 1984, Minor MM 1953 and 1000 1971, Six MS 1953, Eight 1938/1948) and adding engines/dimensions; the Fifteen-Six line had been conflated with the 4-cylinder Oxford 15.9 Empire and was corrected.
